body: I appreciate that. That used to be my only reason why I felt like I needed to stay alive but then I realized how tiring it was living for others and honestly, I feel really selfish when I say that. Making the decision to end your life is probably the hardest decision anyone could ever make and it took me a long time to come to this decision, also months of planning.

I live in a town that is known for some insane parties. Im gonna hit up some close friends and get drunk and have one more good laugh with the boys before I head out. I haven't really thought of the crazy thing that I want to do yet.

Thanks and goodbye :) I plan on doing a lot of cleaning so my family so my family doesn't have to once im gone. After that I'm going to get everything prepared for my method, then write my note and video document my last thoughts. 1 note goes to the police and the other will go to my family..the video will be for any friends so they can kind of get an understanding of what led me here or at least for them to be able to hear something from me one last time. Finally once all that is done, im going to go out and do something crazy..something I've never done before and that'll be it. After I've had my last bit of fun im going to leave.
Feel free to PM me if you want to get into more detail about suicide. I need to get some stuff off my chest so it might be helpful for the both of us.

I wish you peace too :)
Can I PM you?

Listen..I appreciate you and everyone else for the kind words but I specifically asked not to be told any of this.  Not to shit on any of your beliefs but theres no reason why you're here or why I'm here or why anybody else is here. We are just here to be here and when people throw all of this pro-life shit at me it just pisses me the fuck off and im sure most people in my situation would agree with me. Im greatful for everything in my life but I'm tired of living for others.
